provisional_finalists.TEMPORAL_STABILITY_SUMMARY: August: 4 of 4 weekly buckets positive (ROI 7.7% / 18.1% / 14.6% / 12.3%). Chronological tail ROI rises to 18.61%. Largest single-day positive-PnL share 15.0%, largest single-event share 0.06% - no burst concentration.
provisional_finalists.SPORT_MARKET_COMPOSITION: soccer 100% by construction; market family 'unknown' 99.3% (the shadow-strategic export does not populate market_family for soccer), 'Sports' 0.7%.
provisional_finalists.WHY_IT_MAY_TRANSFER_TO_CURRENT_LIVE: Highest ROI of any high-N model on both summer bases and it improves out-of-sample on the held-out tail. Single-dimension predicate over two fields production already computes point-in-time (entry_price, sport_family). Soccer is the deepest, most continuously scheduled market on the venue, so daily executable candidate supply is the least fragile of the three finalists.
provisional_finalists.KNOWN_TRANSFER_RISK: Concentrated in one sport - a soccer-specific pricing regime shift (calendar gap between competitions, or a venue liquidity change in soccer markets) removes the entire edge at once. The 13% ROI is a research-universe figure; the executable subset and its true entry prices are unproven and are the subject of CURRENT_EXECUTABILITY_AND_FINAL_FREEZE_V1.

provisional_finalists.TEMPORAL_STABILITY_SUMMARY: August: 4 of 4 weekly buckets positive (ROI 7.0% / 15.7% / 12.9% / 9.9%). Chronological tail is the highest absolute PnL of all models (+156.40u) at 14.90% ROI. Largest single-day positive-PnL share 13.7%.
provisional_finalists.SPORT_MARKET_COMPOSITION: August selected: soccer 79.0%, tennis 7.8%, cricket 5.2%, baseball 4.4%, esports 2.0%, remainder <1% each. The non-soccer share is entirely the lead_time>=24h arm.
provisional_finalists.WHY_IT_MAY_TRANSFER_TO_CURRENT_LIVE: Already the production-selected single operating model (SINGLE_MODEL_OPERATING_POLICY_SELECTION_V1). Highest absolute PnL over the shared chronological tail window, so per fixed operating period it produces the most money of the three. The C4-minus-C1 arm it adds over C1 was positive on both denominators (discovery +5.56%, tail +6.49%). More sport-diversified than C1, so less exposed to a single-sport regime break.
provisional_finalists.KNOWN_TRANSFER_RISK: The non-soccer lead>=24h arm is the weaker half of the edge (~6% ROI vs ~13-18% for the soccer core) and depends on the venue actually listing 50-60c markets a full day before start with usable liquidity - historically true in research but the live Contract A hard cap of hoursToStart<=6 means production currently never reaches this arm at all. Executability of the >=24h arm is unproven and is the central question for the next mission.

REQUIRED_DECISION_TIME_FIELDS: sport_family (only to exclude nothing - C2 has no sport rule; carried for composition/diagnostic)
provisional_finalists.TEMPORAL_STABILITY_SUMMARY: August: 4 of 4 weekly buckets positive (ROI 5.5% / 17.8% / 11.4% / 10.6%). Chronological tail ROI rises to 13.54%. Max drawdown -14.4u is the shallowest of the three finalists on the August basis. Largest single-day positive-PnL share 13.7%.
provisional_finalists.SPORT_MARKET_COMPOSITION: August selected: soccer 69.9%, tennis 11.2%, cricket 7.4%, baseball 6.4%, esports 2.9%, golf 1.2%, remainder <1%. The most sport-diverse of the three finalists.
provisional_finalists.WHY_IT_MAY_TRANSFER_TO_CURRENT_LIVE: A genuinely different edge from C1/C4: it is sport-agnostic and rests only on the observation that a 50-60c market priced a full day or more before an event is systematically mispriced. Because it does not depend on any one sport it is the most robust of the three to a single-sport regime break, and its drawdown is the smallest. Stable across all four August weeks and improves on the held-out tail.
provisional_finalists.KNOWN_TRANSFER_RISK: The >=24h lead-time arm is structurally unreachable under the current live Contract A pipeline (hard cap hoursToStart<=6). Making C2 executable requires either a distinct early-reservation contour or a change to that cap - which is out of scope here and is the core feasibility question for CURRENT_EXECUTABILITY_AND_FINAL_FREEZE_V1. If early markets in the band turn out to be thin or to move sharply before start, realized entry prices and fills will not match the research figure.
